title: b7z9.16.1(b): wire DAO TX timing orchestrator into the C runtime loop (after (a))
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.16.1. LANDS AFTER (a): call the orchestrator from the C runtime loop where DIOs are processed (dodag.c process path or the node loop): on DODAG join -> on_join; poll due -> build/send DAO (new send site — none exists today); on DAO-ACK -> on_ack. Requires a DAO send site decision (dodag.c vs a new rpl_dao_tx.c) and the Kconfig for the timer cadence.
